news.headline: FLOOD WATCH — NWS Melbourne: Flood Watch for Orange, Osceola, Seminole, Volusia, Brevard & most of east-central Florida through Fri Nov 20 7 PM — 3–6 in. of rain, isolated 8–12 in.; St. Johns River near Cocoa in major flood at 17.13 ft Tue night, high surf / rip-current risk through Friday
Florida single-family closed sales fell 10.1% in October to 19,049; median price rose 2.2% to $420,000, new pending sales dropped 15.7% — third straight month of year-over-year declines
Builder confidence fell 4 points to 25 in November — lowest since April 2012 — NAHB/Wells Fargo HMI; 46% of builders cut prices, buyer traffic fell to 16

Florida's 9th-edition building code takes effect Dec 31 — permit application date governs which edition applies; Miami-Dade portal cutoff is 4 PM Dec 30, with new flood documentation and coastal corrosion rules
Copper at lowest since April Wed — LME 3-month fell 3.7% to $12,742.50/ton, below $13,000, amid strong dollar, China demand and AI-stock selloff concerns
Leap Partners acquires Crowther Heating & Air Conditioning in Kilmarnock, VA — its second Virginia acquisition in two months; 37 HVAC, plumbing and electrical companies acquired in four years

Markets Tue: S&P 500 fell 1.03% to 7,340.53 in a 4th straight decline, Dow fell 1.64% to 50,759.42, Nasdaq fell 0.74%; Fed funds held at 3.75–4.00%, October FOMC minutes due Wed 2 PM ET, markets price ~95% chance of a Dec hike
Florida workers' comp: Commissioner Yaworsky approved NCCI's −7.4% average rate cut for new and renewal policies from Jan 1, 2027 — 11th straight year of reductions
NBA Mon: Magic 115, Celtics 105 — Orlando's 4th straight win, Bane 24 pts · Heat 128, Rockets 110 — Miami's 5th straight win

NFL Nov 17 flex: Titans at Jaguars moves to 1 PM ET Sun Nov 29 on FOX, Jets at Dolphins 1 PM Nov 29, Panthers at Buccaneers Mon Nov 30 8:15 PM on ESPN; Bucs QB Mayfield in walking boot ahead of Sun at Detroit
